    How it works

    Credits for hosting an event or running a fundraiser

    Bring people together for the film and you earn a credit of your own — by what the event achieves, not by a share of the money. The gifts made that night already appear on this wall, credited to the people who gave them.

    • Over $5,000 raised. You are listed in the film’s Special Thanks.
    • Over $25,000 raised. You receive a “Made Possible by” on-screen credit.
    • Matching challenges are different. A challenge credits its dollars to you in full: your own money is at risk, and what it unlocks exists because of your pledge.

    Your event’s total is not shown against your name — the credit is the recognition. Want to host one? Close this and use Host an event.

    Gather your people

    Host a fundraising event for What a Trip

    Thank you for offering to host a fundraising event for our film! We try and align events with Rick’s busy travel schedule. Any event that helps raise over $5k earns our host a Special Thanks credit — and $25k+ gets a “Made Possible by” credit.

    • Let us know what you have in mind and let’s see what we can do.

    Nothing here is binding — a rough idea is plenty to start a conversation. We read these ourselves and write back; no mailing list, no autoresponder.

    Your donation is tax deductible

    Every contribution to What a Trip is tax-deductible to the fullest extent allowed by U.S. law.

    What a Trip is a fiscally sponsored project of Creative Visions Foundation, a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization.

    Donations are processed by Creative Visions’ platform partner, Pledge.to, through the Pledge Foundation, a registered 501(c)(3). Your gift is received and receipted through the Pledge Foundation, so your emailed receipt and tax‑ID acknowledgment will come from them. The funds are then transferred to Creative Visions Foundation and, after platform and fiscal‑sponsorship fees, granted to What a Trip.

    You can give by cash, ACH bank transfer, stock, donor-advised fund (DAF), crypto, or credit card. ACH transfers carry the lowest processing fees, so more of your gift goes straight to the film.

    Right after you give, you’ll receive an emailed receipt to keep for your tax records.

    If you receive a donor perk or experience with commercial value, the fair market value of that perk must be deducted from your donation before calculating your tax deduction.

    Please consult your tax professional about your particular situation.
